Subject: Dalmora Lounge Group - Unable to Quote

Hi Celia,

Thank you for thinking of us for Dalmora Lounge Group. I've reviewed the submission, and unfortunately, we'll need to pass on this opportunity.

Our appetite doesn't currently include nightclubs or bars with entertainment, so we're not able to provide a competitive quote for this risk.

I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty market that focuses on hospitality and entertainment venues—they'll be better positioned to offer appropriate coverage and pricing for this class of business.

I appreciate you considering us, and please keep us in mind for future submissions that might be a better fit!

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
